title: SAMPLE RECALL (demo data, not a real notice): Dishwasher heating element wiring may overheat
hazard: The wiring connector at the heating element can loosen over time and overheat during the heated dry cycle, which poses a fire hazard.
remedy: Stop using the heated dry option and run air-dry cycles only.
Check that the model number on the label inside the door matches the notice.
Contact the manufacturer for a free repair kit and a technician visit.
Keep the confirmation number until the repair is done.

title: SAMPLE RECALL (demo data, not a real notice): Electric kettles may leak from the base seal
hazard: The base seal can crack with repeated heating, letting hot water reach the electrical contacts and creating a shock and burn hazard.
remedy: Stop using the kettle and unplug it.
Find the model number on the underside of the base.
Register for a free replacement base through the manufacturer.

title: SAMPLE RECALL (demo data, not a real notice): Portable space heaters may fail to shut off when tipped
hazard: The tip-over switch can stick, so the heater may keep running after it falls over, which poses a fire hazard.
remedy: Unplug the heater and stop using it.
Check the model number printed on the back panel.
Request a free replacement unit from the manufacturer.
Keep the old unit until the replacement arrives.

title: SAMPLE RECALL (demo data, not a real notice): Smoke alarms may not sound after a battery change
hazard: A battery contact can spring out of position, so the alarm may chirp for a moment but fail to sound in a fire.
remedy: Press the test button every month and confirm the alarm sounds.
If it does not sound, replace the alarm right away.
Contact the manufacturer for a free replacement.
